items.title: Layer 1 blockchain Fogo halts mainnet after attacker receives 400 million FOGO tokens, 10% of circulating supply
items.author: Zack Abrams

metadata.title_en: Layer 1 blockchain Fogo halts mainnet after attacker receives 400 million FOGO tokens
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 29, 2026, Fogo halted its mainnet after an attacker obtained 400 million FOGO tokens, about 10% of circulating supply and worth roughly $3 million.

A Layer 1 blockchain pausing its mainnet over a token-theft incident is a serious security and trust event, affecting users, validators, and DeFi applications built on Fogo. Although the dollar value is modest compared with major exploits, the shutdown highlights how supply-level vulnerabilities can disrupt network operations.

The stolen 400 million FOGO tokens represent about 10% of the circulating supply and roughly 4% of FOGO's genesis supply. At the time of the incident, the tokens were valued at about $3 million.
metadata.background_en: Fogo is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain that is compatible with the Solana Virtual Machine (SVM) and runs exclusively the Firedancer validator client, targeting ultra-low-latency DeFi and trading with sub-40ms block times and 1.3-second finality. A mainnet halt means the network stops producing blocks, an emergency measure taken during critical incidents. The incident revolves around FOGO's token supply: genesis supply refers to tokens created at the network's launch, while circulating supply is the portion available in the market.
metadata.market_impact_en: The incident could affect FOGO's market through potential sell pressure from the attacker's 400 million tokens and through reduced confidence in Fogo's reliability, which may influence trading venues and DeFi protocols that rely on the chain. The transmission channel is primarily token-supply and network-trust risk, rather than a direct change in broader crypto market fundamentals.
metadata.title_zh: Layer 1 公链 Fogo 遭攻击者获取 4 亿 FOGO 代币后暂停主网
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
2026 年 8 月 29 日，Fogo 在攻击者获取 4 亿枚 FOGO 代币后暂停了主网。该数量约占流通供应量的 10%，当时价值约 300 万美元。

Layer 1 区块链因代币被盗事件而暂停主网，是严重的安全与信任事件，会影响 Fogo 上的用户、验证者和 DeFi 应用。尽管与大型攻击事件相比美元金额不大，但此次停机凸显了供应层面的漏洞如何能够扰乱网络运行。

被盗的 4 亿枚 FOGO 代币约占流通供应量的 10%，约占 FOGO 创世供应量的 4%。事发时这些代币价值约 300 万美元。
metadata.background_zh: Fogo 是一个高性能 Layer 1 区块链，兼容 Solana 虚拟机（SVM），并独家运行 Firedancer 验证者客户端，目标是以低于 40 毫秒的出块时间和 1.3 秒的最终性支持超低延迟 DeFi 和交易。主网暂停意味着网络停止产生新区块，这是在发生严重事件时采取的应急措施。此次事件涉及 FOGO 的代币供应：创世供应量指网络启动时创建的代币，而流通供应量是市场上可交易的部分。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次事件可能通过攻击者手中 4 亿枚代币带来的潜在抛售压力，以及市场对 Fogo 可靠性的信心下降，影响 FOGO 的市场表现，并波及依赖该链的交易场所和 DeFi 协议。其传导渠道主要是代币供应和网络信任风险，而非整个加密市场基本面的直接变化。

items.author: shenli3514

metadata.title_en: Tencent Open-Sources Hy4 Preview, a 770B-Parameter MoE Model
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Tencent released and open-sourced Hy4 preview, a next-generation Mixture-of-Experts LLM with 770B total parameters and 49B active parameters. The model quickly gained traction on OpenRouter, processing trillions of tokens within days of release.

This is a major open-source AI release from a top-tier lab, intensifying competition among open-weights models. Hy4's recursive self-improvement experiments and rapid OpenRouter adoption could accelerate progress in the open-source AI ecosystem and shape developer preferences.

Hy4 preview uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 770B total and 49B active parameters, and supports a context window exceeding 1M tokens. Tencent says the model participated in optimizing its own training methods, data strategies, evaluation frameworks, and low-level operators, forming an early recursive self-improvement loop.
metadata.background_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a neural network architecture that activates only a subset of parameters for each input, improving efficiency while keeping a large overall capacity. Recursive self-improvement is a concept in AI research where a system improves the very processes that produce a more capable version of itself, sometimes linked to intelligence-explosion scenarios. Tencent's previous open-source model, Hy3, had 295B parameters, so Hy4 preview represents a substantial scale jump.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters highlighted Hy4's surprisingly strong OpenRouter usage, with trillions of tokens processed in days—more than GLM 5.3 in a week—and noted its low 5% cache cost. Some shared positive hands-on experience with the predecessor Hy3, while one user complained about misleading benchmark chart design in the release material. The recursive self-improvement claim also drew curiosity and comparisons to classic AI-takeoff discussions.
metadata.title_zh: 腾讯开源新一代 Hy4 Preview，7700亿参数 MoE 模型
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
腾讯发布并开源了新一代混合专家（MoE）大语言模型 Hy4 preview，总参数量达7700亿，激活参数为490亿。该模型在 OpenRouter 上线后迅速获得大量使用，数天内处理了数万亿 token。

这是来自顶级实验室的重大开源 AI 发布，加剧了开放权重模型之间的竞争。Hy4 的递归自我改进实验和 OpenRouter 上的快速采用，可能加速开源 AI 生态的发展，并影响开发者的选择。

Hy4 preview 采用混合专家架构，总参数7700亿，激活参数490亿，支持超过100万 token 的上下文窗口。腾讯表示，该模型参与了自身训练方法、数据策略、评估框架和底层算子的自动化优化，形成了早期的递归自我改进循环。
metadata.background_zh: 混合专家（MoE）是一种神经网络架构，每次输入仅激活一部分参数，从而在保持较大整体规模的同时提高效率。递归自我改进是 AI 研究中的一个概念，指系统改进用于产出一个更强大版本的自身流程，有时与智能爆炸相关。腾讯此前开源的 Hy3 模型参数量为2950亿，因此 Hy4 preview 是一个显著的规模跃升。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 评论者强调了 Hy4 在 OpenRouter 上出人意料的强劲使用量，几天内处理了数万亿 token，超过 GLM 5.3 一周的量，并指出其仅为5%的缓存成本。一些用户分享了使用前代 Hy3 的良好体验，也有人批评发布材料中基准图表的误导性设计。递归自我改进的说法也引发了好奇，并被拿来与经典的 AI 快速崛起讨论相比较。

items.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
items.author: meetpateltech

metadata.title_en: OpenAI cuts off Cursor after SpaceX acquisition, citing xAI conflict
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
OpenAI announced it will stop providing its models to Cursor, an AI coding editor, after Cursor was acquired by SpaceXAI (formerly xAI). The decision, made in August 2026, cites conflicts with xAI and concerns over model distillation.

This move reshapes the AI coding tool ecosystem, removing OpenAI models from one of the most widely used AI IDEs. It signals that AI labs are willing to sever ties with tools associated with rivals, potentially driving developers toward alternatives like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or standalone open-source models.

The decision follows Elon Musk's admission that Grok was partly developed via distillation from OpenAI models, which violates typical terms of service. Anthropic had previously banned xAI for similar violations earlier in the year, though it remains unclear whether Anthropic will extend that ban to Cursor.
metadata.background_en: Cursor is an AI-assisted integrated development environment (IDE) and coding agent, forked from Visual Studio Code, developed by Anysphere. In August 2026, Cursor was acquired by SpaceXAI, formerly xAI, Elon Musk's AI company that was acquired by SpaceX and rebranded. The integration raised concerns because xAI had been accused of using distillation — a process where one AI model learns from another's outputs — from OpenAI models to develop its Grok models. OpenAI's decision is part of a broader trend of AI labs policing how their models are used by third-party tools.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Community reaction is mixed. Some users expressed sadness, noting they valued Cursor's ability to switch between OpenAI and Anthropic models. Others predicted this would happen, arguing Cursor's business model of reselling other companies' APIs was unsustainable, and questioned whether Anthropic would maintain its ban given its data center partnership with Musk.
metadata.title_zh: OpenAI 在 SpaceX 收购后切断与 Cursor 的合作，称与 xAI 冲突
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
OpenAI 宣布，在 Cursor 被 SpaceXAI（原 xAI）收购后，将停止向这款 AI 编程编辑器提供其模型。该决定于 2026 年 8 月做出，理由是存在与 xAI 的冲突以及对模型蒸馏的担忧。

此举重塑了 AI 编程工具生态，将 OpenAI 模型从最广泛使用的 AI 集成开发环境之一中移除。这标志着 AI 实验室愿意切断与竞争对手关联工具的合作，可能促使开发者转向 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code 或独立的开源模型等替代方案。

这一决定源于埃隆·马斯克承认 Grok 部分是通过蒸馏 OpenAI 模型开发的，这违反了典型的服务条款。Anthropic 今年早些时候曾因类似违规行为禁止 xAI，但目前尚不清楚 Anthropic 是否会将禁令延伸到 Cursor。
metadata.background_zh: Cursor 是一款 AI 辅助集成开发环境（IDE）和编程代理，源自 Visual Studio Code 的分支，由 Anysphere 开发。2026 年 8 月，Cursor 被 SpaceXAI 收购，该公司原为埃隆·马斯克的 AI 公司 xAI，在被 SpaceX 收购后更名为 SpaceXAI。这次整合引发担忧，因为 xAI 曾被指控使用蒸馏（即一个 AI 模型从另一个模型的输出中学习的过程）从 OpenAI 模型中开发其 Grok 模型。OpenAI 的决定是 AI 实验室更广泛地监督第三方工具如何使用其模型的趋势的一部分。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区反应不一。一些用户表示难过，称他们重视 Cursor 在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型之间切换的能力。另一些人则预测到这一结果，认为 Cursor 转售其他公司 API 的商业模式难以为继，并质疑 Anthropic 是否会因其与马斯克的数据中心合作而维持禁令。

items.title: Deribit moved 90% of client assets to Coinbase, then killed its daily proof-of-reserves check
items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright

metadata.title_en: Deribit Moves 90% of Client Assets to Coinbase, Drops Daily Proof of Reserves
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Deribit will remove its public Proof of Reserves page on Sept. 1 as part of its Coinbase integration, saying roughly 90% of client assets have been moved into Coinbase custody. The removal eliminates daily client-level Merkle verification of balances.

The move reduces public transparency for one of the largest crypto derivatives exchanges, removing a daily tool users could use to independently check solvency. Although Dubai's VARA still mandates reserves, reconciliation, and audits, the change shifts verification from daily public checks to less frequent, request-based disclosures.

Deribit's existing system used a privacy-preserving binary Merkle tree and daily snapshot, letting clients verify their balances and compare aggregate liabilities with published wallet holdings. The exchange has not promised a replacement dashboard or continued client-level Merkle verification, and its methodology already excluded third-party custodians such as Copper ClearLoop.
metadata.background_en: Proof of reserves is a transparency practice in which exchanges cryptographically prove they hold client assets, often by publishing Merkle trees that let users verify their balances are included. Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) requires covered firms to maintain 1:1 reserves, reconcile daily, and obtain independent audits at least every six months. Merkle proofs allow verification of data inclusion without revealing the whole dataset.
metadata.market_impact_en: The change could affect user confidence in Deribit's solvency transparency, potentially influencing withdrawal behavior and liquidity on the platform, which may spill over into broader crypto derivatives market sentiment. However, the underlying regulatory reserve and audit requirements remain unchanged, and there is no evidence of a reserve shortfall.
metadata.title_zh: Deribit将90%客户资产转至Coinbase，取消每日储备证明
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Deribit将于9月1日因与Coinbase整合而移除公开的储备证明页面，并表示约90%的客户资产已转入Coinbase托管。此举取消了客户每日对余额的默克尔验证。

此举降低了这家大型加密衍生品交易所的公开透明度，取消了用户每日独立核查偿付能力的工具。尽管迪拜VARA仍要求储备、对账和审计，但验证方式从每日公开检查转向频率更低、需申请才能获得的披露。

Deribit现有系统使用保护隐私的二叉默克尔树和每日快照，让客户能验证自己的余额，并将总负债与公布的持币地址进行比较。该交易所未承诺提供替代仪表盘或继续客户级默克尔验证，其方法此前已排除Copper ClearLoop等第三方托管资产。
metadata.background_zh: 储备证明是交易所通过密码学方式证明其持有客户资产的一种透明度做法，通常发布默克尔树让用户验证自己的余额是否被包含在内。迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）要求受监管机构维持1:1储备、每日对账，并至少每六个月接受一次独立审计。默克尔证明允许在不泄露整个数据集的情况下验证数据是否被包含。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这一变化可能影响用户对Deribit偿付能力透明度的信心，从而影响该平台的提现行为和流动性，并可能波及更广泛的加密衍生品市场情绪。然而，监管层面的储备和审计要求未变，且没有证据表明存在储备缺口。

items.title: Cosmos Labs says it wrongly cleared the bug behind a $5.7 million six-chain hack
items.author: Zack Abrams

metadata.title_en: Cosmos Labs admits fault in clearing bug behind $5.7M six-chain hack
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Cosmos Labs has admitted it mistakenly cleared the critical vulnerability that enabled a $5.7 million exploit across six blockchains, with MANTRA Chain suffering $3.6 million in losses. The admission comes after MANTRA Chain claimed the patch was released only 20 hours before the attack began.

This incident exposes a significant flaw in vulnerability review within the Cosmos ecosystem, potentially undermining trust in the security of cross-chain infrastructure. Since the exploit affected user funds across multiple chains, it raises concerns about the safety of IBC-based interoperability and the accountability of core developers.

The exploit affected six chains, including an estimated $3.6 million loss for MANTRA Chain. MANTRA Chain said the patch did not identify the flaw it was meant to fix, and was released only 20 hours before the attack began.
metadata.background_en: The Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) protocol allows independent blockchains in the Cosmos network to securely exchange data and value. This interoperability is central to many Cosmos-based chains, but it also means a vulnerability in a shared protocol or dependency can expose multiple chains simultaneously. MANTRA Chain is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain focused on real-world assets, built within the Cosmos ecosystem.
metadata.market_impact_en: This security incident may dampen sentiment around Cosmos-based assets and IBC-linked tokens, as the exploit demonstrated real risk to user funds across multiple chains. The direct channel is through user confidence and a potential reassessment of security standards for cross-chain protocols, rather than any change in token supply or market structure.
metadata.title_zh: Cosmos Labs承认误判漏洞，致六链遭570万美元攻击
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Cosmos Labs承认，它错误放行了导致六个区块链遭570万美元攻击的关键漏洞，其中MANTRA Chain损失360万美元。MANTRA Chain称补丁在攻击发生前20小时才发布，且未指明所修复的缺陷。

该事件暴露出Cosmos生态在漏洞审查方面的重大缺陷，并可能削弱人们对跨链基础设施安全性的信任。由于攻击波及多条链上的用户资金，这引发对基于IBC的互操作安全以及核心开发团队责任感的担忧。

该攻击影响了六条链，其中MANTRA Chain损失约360万美元。MANTRA Chain表示，补丁在攻击前20小时才发布，且没有指明其要修复的缺陷。
metadata.background_zh: 跨链通信（IBC）协议允许Cosmos网络中独立的区块链安全地交换数据和价值。这种互操作性对许多基于Cosmos的链至关重要，但也意味着共享协议或依赖项中的漏洞可能同时波及多条链。MANTRA Chain是一条兼容EVM的Layer 1区块链，专注于现实世界资产，构建于Cosmos生态内。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次安全事件可能削弱市场对Cosmos生态相关资产及IBC相关代币的情绪，因为攻击展示出多链用户资金的现实风险。其传导路径主要是用户信心变化，以及市场可能重新评估跨链协议的安全标准，而非代币供给或市场结构的改变。

items.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

metadata.title_en: Trump-Promoted Brand's GOLD Token Collapses 99% After Team Sell-Off
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A Solana-based token called 'Trump Digital GOLD' was promoted by the Trump-linked Real Trump Coins X account and collapsed about 99% within hours, after blockchain analytics firm Lookonchain reported that 15 team-linked wallets dumped 224.5 million GOLD tokens for roughly 3,178 SOL (~$330,000). The promotional posts were later deleted from X.

The episode highlights the risks of celebrity- and politician-linked memecoins, where insider dumping can wipe out retail investors within hours. It also intensifies scrutiny of Trump-associated crypto ventures while the administration pushes Congress to reshape crypto regulation.

Lookonchain noted the token developer held 600 million GOLD while 15 newly created wallets spent $18,657 to buy another 224.5 million tokens, giving the team roughly 82.45% of the total supply. After the 15 wallets sold all of their GOLD for 3,178 SOL (~$330,000), the token's market capitalization fell from about $50 million to $500,000; the Real Trump Coins website still promoted GOLD with a 4% trading fee and a pledge to use 99% of fees for buybacks.
metadata.background_en: A 'rug pull' is a crypto scam in which developers hype a token, attract buyers, then sell their holdings or drain liquidity, leaving investors with near-worthless coins. Real Trump Coins was publicly touted by President Trump in September 2024 as the exclusive site to buy his silver medallions, though the site says products are not made or sold by the Trump Organization. The GOLD token launched on Solana, a blockchain known for fast, low-cost trading and a booming ecosystem of memecoins.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Community reaction was sharply skeptical: Solana community member Fabiano.sol claimed the Real Trump Coins X account had been hacked, onchain analyst EmberCN labeled GOLD a scam, and X user TITAN alleged Iranian hackers were behind a 'fake Trump launch.' The consensus among those cited was that the token launch was fraudulent or compromised.
metadata.market_impact_en: The collapse is most directly felt by GOLD token holders, but it also hits sentiment across Trump-branded and meme tokens, which often trade on hype and social-media promotion. Because GOLD traded on Solana-based DEXs, the incident could reinforce caution toward newly launched tokens in that ecosystem, affecting liquidity and trading volumes rather than indicating any systemic risk.
metadata.title_zh: 特朗普推广品牌的GOLD代币在团队抛售后暴跌99%
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
一款名为“Trump Digital GOLD”的Solana链上代币经特朗普关联品牌Real Trump Coins的X账号推广后，在数小时内暴跌约99%。区块链数据分析平台Lookonchain报告称，15个与团队相关的钱包抛售了2.245亿枚GOLD，换取约3,178枚SOL（约33万美元），相关推广帖随后被删除。

这一事件凸显了与名人及政客挂钩的迷因币的风险——内部人员抛售可在数小时内让散户投资者血本无归。在特朗普政府推动国会重塑加密监管之际，此事也加剧了对特朗普关联加密项目的审视。

Lookonchain指出，代币开发者持有6亿枚GOLD，而15个新建钱包花费18,657美元购买了另外2.245亿枚代币，使团队控制了总供应量约82.45%。这15个钱包将全部GOLD卖出换取3,178枚SOL（约33万美元）后，代币市值从约5,000万美元跌至50万美元。Real Trump Coins网站仍在推广GOLD，宣传4%的交易费，并承诺将99%的交易费用于回购。
metadata.background_zh: “拉地毯”（rug pull）是一种加密骗局：开发人员炒作代币吸引买家，然后抛售持仓或抽走流动性，使投资者持有近乎一文不值的代币。Real Trump Coins在2024年9月被特朗普总统公开宣传为其银质纪念章的唯一购买网站，但该网站声明相关产品并非由特朗普集团制造或销售。GOLD代币基于Solana区块链发布，该链以快速、低成本的交易和蓬勃发展的迷因币生态著称。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区反应极为怀疑：Solana社区成员Fabiano.sol声称Real Trump Coins的X账号遭到黑客入侵，链上分析师EmberCN称GOLD是骗局，X用户TITAN则指控伊朗黑客策划了这次“虚假的特朗普发布”。被引用的观点普遍认为此次代币发行属于欺诈或账号被盗。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次暴跌最直接打击的是GOLD代币持有者，但也冲击了特朗普品牌及迷因币的整体情绪——这类代币通常依靠炒作和社交媒体推广来交易。由于GOLD在基于Solana的去中心化交易所交易，该事件可能让投资者对Solana生态中新发行的代币更加谨慎，从而影响流动性和交易量，而不代表存在系统性风险。

items.title: Polygon Labs issues urgent client upgrade notice following Austin and Kyoto hardforks
items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright

metadata.title_en: Polygon Labs Urges Node Upgrades After Austin, Kyoto Hardforks
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Polygon Labs issued an urgent notice requiring Polygon PoS node operators to upgrade Bor to v2.10.0 or later and Heimdall to v0.11.0 or later after the Austin and Kyoto hardforks activated. Nodes that remained on pre-hardfork binaries have already fallen out of canonical consensus and must catch up to rejoin the network.

The upgrade is mandatory for all Polygon PoS nodes that want to stay in consensus, making it critical for validators and infrastructure providers. It also ships security hardening fixes that reduce resource-exhaustion and liveness risks, strengthening the network ahead of further architectural transitions.

Austin capped gas consumption during Bor's processing of state-sync bridge events and removed the unbounded TxDependency extra-data field, while Kyoto added nesting checks for protobuf.Any messages, capped fee-coin lists, and fixed several checkpoint and signature edge cases. Both hardforks are plain binary upgrades with no state migration, so non-diverged nodes do not need a resync.
metadata.background_en: Polygon PoS runs two core clients: Bor, the EVM-compatible execution client that processes transactions, and Heimdall, the consensus layer that validates Bor blocks and submits checkpoints to Ethereum. Hardforks are coordinated protocol upgrades that change client rules, and nodes that do not upgrade can fall out of canonical consensus. The Austin hardfork activated at mainnet block 91,949,700, while Kyoto activated at height 51,533,000 on Aug. 18.
metadata.market_impact_en: The mandatory upgrade is an operational, consensus-critical event for Polygon PoS rather than a direct market catalyst. If a meaningful share of validators failed to upgrade promptly, network liveness could suffer, potentially weighing on sentiment toward Polygon's token, but no mainnet disruption has been confirmed.

items.author: firefax

metadata.title_en: DHS Uses Obscure 1509 Summons to Secretly Obtain Records of Journalists and Nonprofits
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The Department of Homeland Security has been using an obscure administrative subpoena known as a 1509 summons to secretly obtain phone and communication records of journalists, non-profits, and unions, often withdrawing the summons once challenged in court to avoid a ruling on its legality.

This practice raises serious Fourth Amendment concerns because the summons is issued without a judge's oversight, allowing the government to bypass the normal warrant process. It affects press freedom, privacy rights, and the ability of advocacy groups to operate without fear of government surveillance.

The 1509 summons is an administrative subpoena intended exclusively for investigations of illegal imports or unpaid customs duties under Title 19 of the U.S. Code. In one case, DHS obtained six months of phone records from T-Mobile for a journalist, including more than 10,000 calls and text messages, without notifying her until months later.
metadata.background_en: Federal agencies often use administrative subpoenas to compel third parties, such as telecom companies, to hand over customer records without a court order. The 1509 customs summons is a specific type of administrative subpoena that is legally limited to customs and import-related investigations, but DHS has been using it to obtain data from tech companies and other organizations in ways that civil liberties advocates argue exceeds its authority.
metadata.community_discussion_en: HN commenters criticized DHS for deliberately avoiding judicial review and blamed companies like T-Mobile for complying without a fight, while noting Google resisted. Some suggested self-hosting or alternative infrastructure as a response, and others debated whether a judge in the loop is required by the Fourth Amendment.

items.title: The SEC is reviewing automatic filing pathways after exotic crypto and event-linked ETF proposals flooded the market
items.author: Andjela Radmilac

metadata.title_en: SEC Reviews Automatic ETF Filing Pathways Amid Exotic Crypto Proposals
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The SEC issued a June 30 concept release requesting public comment on whether its automatic ETF filing pathways can adequately handle exotic products, including crypto assets, event-linked contracts, leveraged strategies, and private assets. Comments are due August 31.

The review could reshape how crypto and event-linked ETFs are approved and regulated in the US, affecting product complexity, custody, liquidity, and valuation requirements. It signals that the SEC is scrutinizing whether familiar ETF tickers are masking unfamiliar risks as assets under management in US ETFs grew from $4 trillion to $12 trillion.

Rule 6c-11, adopted in 2019, let qualifying ETFs under the 1940 Act launch without individual exemptive orders, helping the product count more than double to over 4,600. The SEC is examining whether existing staff authority and review time are sufficient for spot Bitcoin and Ethereum commodity-trust structures, exchange-traded notes, and other non-1940-Act vehicles.
metadata.background_en: An ETF is an investment fund whose shares trade intraday on an exchange, with an authorized-participant creation/redemption mechanism that keeps the market price close to net asset value. Early ETFs required individual exemptive orders from the SEC, but Rule 6c-11 standardized the process for funds registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940. However, spot crypto ETFs typically use commodity-trust structures registered under the Securities Act of 1933, and exchange-traded notes are unsecured debt instruments, so the same 'ETF' label covers very different legal and risk profiles.
metadata.market_impact_en: The SEC's review directly targets the regulatory pathway used by spot crypto and event-linked ETFs; any tightening of custody, liquidity, valuation, or complexity standards could alter how such products are structured and how easily they reach US investors. This creates regulatory uncertainty for crypto asset managers and exchanges but does not by itself signal any specific price direction for digital assets.

此次审查可能重塑美国对加密和事件关联ETF的批准与监管方式，影响产品复杂性、托管、流动性和估值要求。它表明SEC正在审视熟悉的ETF代码是否掩盖了日益陌生的风险——美国ETF资产规模已从4万亿美元增长到12万亿美元。

2019年通过的6c-11规则允许符合1940年法案条件的ETF无需逐一申请豁免令即可推出，促使产品数量翻倍至4,600多只。SEC正在审查现有员工权限和审查时间是否足以应对比特币和以太坊现货商品信托结构、交易所交易票据（ETN）以及其他非1940年法案工具。
metadata.background_zh: ETF是一种可在交易所日内交易的基金，通过授权参与人的申购赎回机制使市价接近资产净值。早期ETF需要SEC逐只发放豁免令，而2019年的6c-11规则为在1940年《投资公司法》下注册的基金标准化了这一流程。不过，现货加密ETF通常采用在1933年《证券法》下注册的商品信托结构，交易所交易票据则是无担保债务工具，因此同一个'ETF'标签下覆盖的法律和风险属性差异很大。
metadata.market_impact_zh: SEC此次审查直接针对现货加密和事件关联ETF所依赖的监管通道；一旦收紧托管、流动性、估值或产品复杂性标准，可能改变这些产品的结构及其进入美国投资者视野的难易程度。这给加密资产管理机构和交易所带来监管不确定性，但本身并不意味着数字资产价格会有任何确定方向。

metadata.title_en: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in Austin and Kyoto hard forks
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Polygon Labs disclosed previously private security vulnerabilities in its Bor and Heimdall clients that were silently patched via the Austin and Kyoto hard forks before public disclosure. The flaws included denial-of-service risks, validator resource exhaustion, and checkpoint/milestone processing issues.

This disclosure matters because it reveals that Polygon's proof-of-stake network faced serious stability threats that could have disrupted consensus. It also underscores the importance of timely patching, since nodes running older client versions have already fallen out of consensus.

The most severe issue was in Heimdall, where a specially crafted transaction could force validators to do excessive processing work. Bor v2.10.0 is now required for all Polygon PoS nodes, and Heimdall v0.11.0 is required for validators and full nodes; both upgrades are already active on mainnet.
metadata.background_en: Polygon PoS is a proof-of-stake blockchain that uses two main client components: Heimdall, a Tendermint-based validator layer that handles checkpointing and milestones, and Bor, the block-producing layer. Hard forks are protocol upgrades; the Austin and Kyoto forks were deployed privately and tested before activation, allowing fixes to ship without alerting attackers.
metadata.market_impact_en: POL is the native token of Polygon PoS, so the disclosure touches validator economics and network security sentiment; however, because the vulnerabilities were already patched and no exploits were observed, the direct market transmission is limited. The main channel is sentiment-based, as security disclosures can raise short-term caution among POL holders despite no active user impact.

metadata.title_en: BitGo Buys NYDIG's Institutional Trading Arm for $42.5M
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
BitGo has completed the acquisition of NYDIG's institutional trading business for about $42.5 million, adding derivatives, structured products, financing, and capital-markets solutions. The deal includes roughly 30 employees and is structured as a two-step merger with $7 million cash and about $35.5 million in BitGo stock.

This consolidation strengthens BitGo's trading platform to offer institutions custody, trading, financing, and settlement under one roof. It signals growing demand for full-lifecycle digital asset services among asset managers, hedge funds, and family offices, and sharpens NYDIG's focus on mining and HPC data centers.

NYDIG's sale includes earnout provisions, including a $10 million cash payment tied to one revenue milestone and up to $5 million more plus additional shares tied to a second. NYDIG will concentrate on its power-generation, Bitcoin mining, and high-performance computing data-center business, which has a development pipeline exceeding 3 gigawatts.
metadata.background_en: BitGo is a digital-asset infrastructure firm known for regulated custody, settlement, and wallet services, and it recently went public on the NYSE with a valuation around $2 billion. NYDIG is a Bitcoin-focused company that offers investment, trading, and mining solutions; the trading unit being acquired serves asset managers, hedge funds, corporates, and family offices. The deal reflects a broader trend of institutional crypto players consolidating to offer a wider range of services and the growing importance of derivatives and financing in crypto markets.
metadata.market_impact_en: The acquisition consolidates institutional crypto trading and custody infrastructure, potentially affecting competitive dynamics among prime brokers and custodians. It may influence how institutional clients access derivatives and financing, with implications for liquidity and market structure across major crypto trading venues, though no directional price impact is implied.

metadata.title_en: US Sanctions Italian Hosting Collective Autistici/Inventati as Terrorist Group
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The U.S. State and Treasury Departments designated the Italian collective Autistici/Inventati (A/I) as a global terrorist entity, imposing sanctions that prohibit U.S. persons from dealing with the organization. The designation also affects A/I's hosting services, including the noblogs.org blogging platform.

This is the first time the U.S. has designated a longstanding privacy-preserving hosting provider as a terrorist entity, creating a chilling precedent for infrastructure used by activists, journalists, and dissidents. The move could deter providers from offering encrypted email, anonymous blogging, and similar tools for fear of legal or financial retaliation.

A/I was founded in 2001 by individuals and collectives from Italy's autonomous anticapitalist movement and runs services such as autistici.org email and noblogs.org, a blogging platform. According to reports, the designation was announced alongside sanctions on Palestine Action and Masar Badil, and A/I's websites were reportedly unreachable or partially dysfunctional after the action.
metadata.background_en: Autistici/Inventati, pronounced roughly "au-tis-ti-chi / in-ven-ta-ti," is an Italian collective that provides free communication tools—such as email, blogs, and file sharing—to activists, artists, and dissidents. The U.S. designation appears to rely on the authority to label organizations as Specially Designated Global Terrorists, which freezes any U.S.-linked assets and criminalizes material support. Commenters note that the collective's roots go back to protests around the 2001 G8 summit in Genoa, where members helped build media infrastructure for the movement.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Comments on Hacker News express alarm that designating infrastructure providers as terrorists sets a dangerous precedent, with users asking whether this could later apply to I2P, Monero, Tox, Signal, or other privacy tools. Others provide historical context about A/I's roots in the Genoa G8 protests and dispute whether there is solid evidence that the collective directly supported the PKK.
metadata.market_impact_en: The sanctions do not directly target any cryptocurrency, but they heighten the regulatory risk perception around privacy-preserving infrastructure and anonymity tools, which could indirectly affect sentiment for privacy-focused crypto assets such as Monero. No direct market transmission is visible from the announcement itself, and any effect would be sentiment-driven rather than a change in on-chain fundamentals.
metadata.title_zh: 美国将意大利托管组织Autistici/Inventati列为恐怖组织实施制裁

这是美国首次将一个长期提供隐私保护的托管服务商认定为恐怖实体，为面向活动人士、记者和异见人士的基础设施开创了令人担忧的先例。此举可能让服务商因担心法律或金融报复而不敢提供加密邮件、匿名博客等工具。

A/I成立于2001年，由意大利自治反资本主义运动中的个人和集体创建，运营autistici.org邮箱服务以及博客平台noblogs.org。据报道，此次认定与对Palestine Action和Masar Badil的制裁一同宣布，且行动后A/I的网站一度无法访问或部分功能失效。
metadata.background_zh: Autistici/Inventati（大致读作“au-tis-ti-chi / in-ven-ta-ti”）是意大利的一个集体，为活动人士、艺术家和异见者提供免费通信工具，如电子邮件、博客和文件共享。美国的认定似乎依据“特别指定全球恐怖分子”相关授权，该授权会冻结涉美资产并将提供物质支持定为犯罪。评论者提到，该集体的渊源可追溯至2001年热那亚八国集团峰会期间的抗议活动，当时成员曾帮助为抗议运动搭建媒体基础设施。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News上的评论表达了警觉，认为将基础设施服务商认定为恐怖分子开创了危险的先例，有用户质疑这是否会蔓延到I2P、Monero、Tox、Signal等隐私工具。其他人提供了A/I起源于热那亚八国集团抗议活动的历史背景，并质疑该集体是否真有直接支持库尔德工人党（PKK）的确凿证据。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次制裁并未直接针对任何加密货币，但加剧了围绕隐私保护基础设施和匿名工具的监管风险认知，可能间接影响Monero等以隐私为特色的加密资产的市场情绪。公告本身没有可见的直接市场传导路径，任何影响都将是情绪驱动，而非链上基本面的变化。

dedup_history.author: Decrypt Agent

metadata.title_en: Judge Rules Trump Administration Illegally Retaliated Against Anthropic
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A federal judge granted Anthropic summary judgment on its First Amendment, due process, and Administrative Procedure Act claims, ruling the Trump administration illegally retaliated against the company for refusing military use of its AI. The government also conceded it has no backdoor access to Anthropic's deployed models and that Claude is no riskier than any other AI system.

This landmark ruling protects AI companies from government retaliation for their policy positions, reinforcing First Amendment protections for corporate speech and limiting executive power. It sets a legal precedent that could curb future administrations' ability to blacklist companies based on political disagreements.

Judge Rita Lin's 59-page order vacated the Defense Department's designation and boycott order, granted a permanent injunction, and denied the government's request for a seven-day administrative stay. Anthropic lost its claim that Trump's directive exceeded presidential power, and the judge entered judgment for agencies that took no action.
metadata.background_en: The dispute began when the Pentagon demanded Anthropic strip usage restrictions and accept a clause permitting "all lawful uses," while Anthropic maintained two red lines against mass surveillance of Americans and lethal autonomous warfare. In February, Trump ordered federal agencies to stop using Anthropic's technology and called it a "RADICAL LEFT, WOKE COMPANY"; Defense Secretary Hegseth barred military contractors from doing business with it. The court found the timing, including Hegseth's prior consideration of the Defense Production Act, showed retaliation rather than national security, and wrote that "the empty invocation of national security is not a blank check to punish and retaliate against government critics."
metadata.title_zh: 法官裁定特朗普政府非法报复Anthropic
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
联邦法官就Anthropic提出的第一修正案、正当程序和《行政程序法》索赔作出即决判决，裁定特朗普政府因其拒绝军方使用其AI而对其进行非法报复。政府还承认无法后门访问Anthropic已部署的模型，且Claude的风险并不高于其他AI系统。

这一里程碑式裁决保护了AI公司因政策立场而免受政府报复，强化了对公司言论的第一修正案保护，并限制了行政权力。它开创的法律先例可能制约未来政府基于政治分歧将企业列入黑名单的能力。

法官Rita Lin的59页命令撤销了国防部的认定和抵制令，授予永久禁令，并拒绝了政府提出的七天行政暂缓执行请求。Anthropic关于特朗普指令超越总统权力的主张未获支持，法官同时对未采取行动的机构作出判决。
metadata.background_zh: 争议起因于五角大楼要求Anthropic删除使用限制并接受允许"所有合法用途"的条款，而Anthropic坚持两条红线，反对大规模监控美国人和致命自主作战。2月，特朗普下令联邦各机构停止使用Anthropic的技术，并在Truth Social上称其为"激进的左翼、觉醒公司"；国防部长赫格塞斯禁止军工承包商与其开展业务。法院认为，包括赫格塞斯此前考虑援引《国防生产法》在内的时机表明这是报复而非出于国家安全，并写道"空洞地援引国家安全并非惩罚和报复政府批评者的空白支票"。

dedup_history.title: Cosmos misjudged a critical bug for 4 months before hackers stole nearly $6 million across 6 chains
dedup_history.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo

metadata.title_en: Cosmos misjudged critical EVM bug for 4 months before $6M cross-chain exploit
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 28, Cosmos Labs disclosed that a misjudged EVM vulnerability was exploited across six networks, including MANTRA, TAC, and KiiChain, causing nearly $6 million in losses. The flaw was first reported on April 25 but was deemed low-risk due to decimal assumptions; a silent patch was merged on May 15, and the real exploit began on August 20 after the assessment was revised.

This incident exposes a months-long triage failure in a shared software layer — Cosmos EVM — that provides Ethereum compatibility to Cosmos SDK chains. With roughly 40 networks potentially affected and 11 previously unknown deployments discovered, it raises urgent questions about security disclosure and patch distribution across the broader Cosmos ecosystem.

The exploit combined two accounting failures: an unsigned-integer underflow created an abnormally large balance, which was then used to overflow another account and extract its legitimate balance without increasing total token supply. Cosmos Labs contacted 40 networks, with 13 potentially exposed chains patching, halting, or applying mitigations; MANTRA suffered the largest disclosed hit, with about 720.9 million tokens moved from two unauthorized addresses.
metadata.background_en: Cosmos EVM is a shared software layer that gives Cosmos SDK chains Ethereum-compatible functionality. MANTRA is an institutional-focused Layer-1 blockchain built for real-world asset tokenization, and KiiChain is described as an onchain FX layer for stablecoins and RWAs. The initial vulnerability assessment assumed only six-decimal networks were affected, while known production chains used 18 decimals; further research in early August showed deployments were vulnerable regardless of decimal configuration.
metadata.market_impact_en: The exploit directly affects tokens on the affected chains; attackers converted roughly $2.87 million through decentralized exchanges and about $2.85 million through centralized venues, with some related accounts frozen. The disclosure of a months-long triage failure could weaken confidence in Cosmos EVM deployments and influence risk sentiment for related assets and DeFi activity, though the overall impact depends on how quickly the ecosystem restores trust.
metadata.title_zh: Cosmos 误判关键 EVM 漏洞达 4 个月，导致约 600 万美元跨链被盗
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
8 月 28 日，Cosmos Labs 披露一个被误判的 EVM 漏洞在包括 MANTRA、TAC 和 KiiChain 在内的六个网络上被利用，造成近 600 万美元损失。该漏洞于 4 月 25 日首次上报，但因小数位假设被评估为低风险；5 月 15 日合并了静默补丁，而在评估修正后，实际攻击始于 8 月 20 日。

该事件暴露出共享软件层 Cosmos EVM 在数月内的安全分级失误，而这一层为 Cosmos SDK 链提供以太坊兼容性。由于约 40 条网络可能受影响，并在响应过程中发现 11 个此前未知的部署，这引发了关于整个 Cosmos 生态中安全披露和补丁分发的紧迫问题。

该漏洞利用结合了两个记账缺陷：无符号整数下溢生成了异常巨大的余额，随后利用该状态使另一个账户溢出，从而在不增加总代币供应量的情况下提取其合法余额。Cosmos Labs 联系了 40 条网络，其中 13 条潜在暴露的链进行了修补、暂停或部署缓解措施；MANTRA 遭受了已披露的最大损失，约有 7.209 亿枚代币从两个未授权地址被转出。
metadata.background_zh: Cosmos EVM 是一个共享软件层，为 Cosmos SDK 链提供以太坊兼容功能。MANTRA 是面向机构的 Layer-1 区块链，专为现实世界资产代币化而构建；KiiChain 被描述为用于稳定币和 RWA 的链上外汇层。最初的漏洞评估假设只有六位小数的网络受影响，而已知的生产链使用 18 位小数；8 月初的进一步研究表明，无论小数配置如何，部署都是易受攻击的。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该漏洞利用直接影响受影响链上的代币；攻击者通过去中心化交易所兑换了约 287 万美元，通过中心化平台兑换了约 285 万美元，部分相关账户已被冻结。长达数月的安全分级失误被披露，可能会削弱对 Cosmos EVM 部署的信心，并影响相关资产和 DeFi 活动中的风险情绪，但整体影响取决于生态系统恢复信任的速度。

dedup_history.title: Solana Will Now Print Less SOL as Disinflation Vote Passes in Dramatic Fashion
dedup_history.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.title_en: Solana Approves Doubled Disinflation, Slashing SOL Issuance by 2029
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Solana validators passed SGP-0002, doubling the disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, so SOL's issuance floor of 1.5% will be reached in 2029 instead of 2032. The vote closed at 67.0% support, barely clearing the 66.67% threshold, with 60.7% quorum participation.

This is the first binding on-chain governance decision in Solana's history, setting a precedent for tokenholder-driven protocol changes. The accelerated supply reduction could tighten SOL's supply schedule and is widely expected to be a long-term positive for the token, though it also lowers staking yields.

The proposal tracks SIMD-550, authored by engineers at infrastructure firm Helius, and passed with 176.29 million SOL in favor and 66.19 million against across 1,326 votes. Validators also ratified the Solana Constitution (SGP-0001) with 86% support, while rejecting SGP-0003, a Resource and Inclusion Fee that would have burned up to 14 times more SOL daily.
metadata.background_en: Solana's inflation rate started at 8% annually and was designed to decrease by 15% per year, converging to a long-term floor of 1.5%. Doubling that disinflation rate accelerates the schedule. Governance on Solana uses stake-weighted voting, where validators and their delegators vote on-chain through the new Solana Governance Proposal (SGP) system; SGP-0002 was the first binding vote under this system. The reduction in issuance will mean about 18.9 million fewer SOL created over the next six years.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Reaction was split: some staking providers, including Kraken, initially voted against the proposal over staking-yield concerns, while Galaxy initially abstained before both flipped in the final hour. Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi said custodians should be 'conduits, not voices,' while Helius CEO Mert Mumtaz lobbied strongly in favor. Investors generally welcomed the outcome as bullish for SOL, though stakers face lower yields, estimated to fall from about 5.25% to 2.25% within three years.
metadata.market_impact_en: The change reduces SOL's annual new-token issuance and pulls the 1.5% floor forward to 2029, lowering the supply side of SOL's market by roughly 18.9 million tokens over six years. This can affect market sentiment and staking behavior across centralized exchanges and DeFi venues; lower yields could discourage staking, while reduced emissions may reduce sell pressure from rewards. No directional price outcome is implied.
metadata.title_zh: Solana 通过加倍通缩提案，提前削减 SOL 发行量
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Solana 验证者通过了 SGP-0002，将年度通缩率从 15% 提高至 30%，使 SOL 的 1.5% 发行下限提前到 2029 年而非 2032 年到达。投票以 67.0% 的支持率勉强超过 66.67% 的门槛，参与率为 60.7%。

这是 Solana 历史上首个具有约束力的链上治理决定，为代币持有者驱动的协议变更开创了先例。加速的供应缩减可能使 SOL 的供应时间表收紧，市场普遍认为这对 SOL 长期有利，但也降低了质押收益率。

该提案对应由基础设施公司 Helius 工程师提出的 SIMD-550，最终以 1.76 亿 SOL 赞成、6619 万 SOL 反对的结果通过，共 1326 票参与。验证者还以 86% 的支持率通过了 Solana 宪法（SGP-0001），但否决了 SGP-0003 资源与纳入费提案，该提案原本可能每日销毁多达 14 倍的 SOL。
metadata.background_zh: Solana 的年化通胀率起初为 8%，设计上每年下降 15%（即通缩率），并逐步收敛至 1.5% 的长期下限。将通缩率加倍后，这一过程会加速。Solana 的治理采用质押权重投票，验证者及其委托者通过新的 Solana 治理提案（SGP）系统在链上投票；SGP-0002 是该系统下的首个具有约束力的投票。发行量缩减意味着未来六年将减少约 1890 万个新 SOL。

metadata.title_en: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3 as open-weight model
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Z.ai has released GLM-5.3, its latest flagship open-weight model, featuring substantial post-training improvements over GLM-5.2. The model is now available through third-party providers such as DeepInfra on OpenRouter.

This release strengthens the open-weight ecosystem, giving developers a competitive, locally deployable alternative to frontier closed models. It also highlights how Chinese labs are using post-training to close the gap with leading models.

GLM-5.3 uses the same base model as GLM-5.2, with all gains coming from extended post-training focused on software engineering and agentic tasks. A faster variant, GLM-5.3-Flash, powers Z.ai's consumer assistant.
metadata.background_en: Open-weight models release the trained parameters of a neural network so anyone can download, run, and fine-tune them, in contrast to API-only closed models. Z.ai is the international arm of Chinese AI lab Zhipu AI, and GLM is its family of large language models. Post-training is the process of refining a pre-trained base model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to shape its behavior for real-world tasks.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters were largely positive, with one describing GLM-5.3 as 'pretty amazing' and another saying it feels like Opus 4.8 in the best way. Some noted it is slightly behind Kimi in raw ability but easier to run, and others expressed skepticism about the safety justifications of closed labs, citing the refusal to open older models like GPT-3.

metadata.title_en: Judge rules Trump administration's blacklisting of Anthropic illegal
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal, citing a slim administrative record and retaliatory behavior. The court found that the government's justification was insufficient and that the action was motivated by retaliation for Anthropic's speech.

This ruling creates an important precedent for how courts scrutinize national-security justifications for government action against AI companies. It signals that while evidence deficiencies might be tolerated, retaliatory intent will not, which could curb aggressive regulation of AI labs.

The court described the administrative record as "slim"—a four-page memo that post-dated two of the three challenged actions. The government also retreated from its earlier risk assessment, which had claimed Anthropic's AI could have "backdoor access" once deployed in national security systems.
metadata.background_en: The case stems from Trump-administration actions that restricted Anthropic's access to government systems or contracts, reportedly on national-security grounds. Anthropic is a leading AI company known for its Claude models and a strong emphasis on AI safety. The ruling distinguishes between insufficient evidence (which can be excused under national-security deference) and unlawful retaliatory intent (which cannot), making the intent finding the crux. The court's willingness to look past the deferential standard highlights the importance of motive in such cases.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters generally agreed with the court's distinction between weak evidence and retaliatory intent, with one noting that public administration statements made the intent finding strong. Some expected Anthropic to seek financial damages for the time its products were barred. Others criticized the legal system's slow pace relative to modern threats.

一名联邦法官裁定，特朗普政府对Anthropic的列入黑名单行为非法，理由是行政记录单薄且行为具有报复性。法院认定，政府的理由不充分，并认为该行动是出于对Anthropic言论的报复。

该裁决为法院如何审查政府对AI公司采取行动的国家安全理由创立了重要先例。它表明，虽然证据不足可能被容忍，但报复性意图则不会被接受，这可能会抑制对AI实验室的激进监管。

法院称行政记录“单薄”——一份四页的备忘录，其形成时间晚于三项受质疑行动中的两项。政府还放弃了早先的风险评估，该评估声称Anthropic的AI在被部署到国家安全系统后可能存在“后门访问”。

dedup_history.title: Bitcoin now has a quantum computing escape route, but 7 million BTC may still be exposed
dedup_history.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo

metadata.title_en: Bitcoin Executes First Quantum-Safe Mainnet Transaction; 7M BTC Still Exposed
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On Aug. 26, Bitcoin confirmed its first quantum-safe mainnet transaction using StarkWare researcher Avihu Levy's Quantum-Safe Bitcoin (QSB) construction, included in block 964,199 via MARA's Slipstream service. The transaction uses hash-based security instead of elliptic-curve signatures and required no consensus change.

This is the first live demonstration that Bitcoin holders can move funds to quantum-resistant spending conditions today, without waiting for a protocol upgrade. However, it also highlights that roughly 7 million BTC with already-visible public keys remain vulnerable, underscoring the need for a broader soft-fork-based migration path.

QSB works by varying candidate transaction data until the signature hash is valid under Bitcoin's rules, shifting security from elliptic-curve cryptography to hash reversal; the approach offers roughly 118-bit resistance against Shor's algorithm. The transaction is valid under consensus rules but nonstandard under default node policy, so it was submitted directly to miner MARA via Slipstream, with costs in the hundreds of dollars.
metadata.background_en: Most Bitcoin addresses keep the public key hidden behind a hash until the coins are first spent, which creates a window before an attacker can derive the private key with a quantum computer. QSB exploits that window by creating a hash-based spending condition before the classical public key is revealed. Roughly 7 million BTC are considered exposed because their public keys are already visible — for example, pay-to-public-key outputs, Taproot outputs, and reused addresses. A future quantum attacker with Shor's algorithm could target those keys directly.
metadata.market_impact_en: The event is primarily a technical proof-of-concept, so it has no direct price mechanism, but it could shape sentiment around Bitcoin's long-term quantum risk among institutions. If demand for QSB-style migrations grows, services like MARA's Slipstream for nonstandard transactions could see more usage, although high cost and nonstandard status currently limit scale.
metadata.title_zh: 比特币完成首笔量子安全主网交易，约700万枚BTC仍面临风险
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
8月26日，比特币主网确认了首笔量子安全交易，该交易使用StarkWare研究员Avihu Levy提出的QSB（Quantum-Safe Bitcoin）方案，并经MARA的Slipstream服务纳入区块964,199。该交易以哈希安全性取代椭圆曲线签名，且无需更改共识规则。

这是首次在实际主网中证明，比特币持有者无需等待协议升级，即可将资金迁移到抗量子的花费条件。但该事件也凸显出约700万枚公钥已暴露的BTC仍处于风险之中，说明更全面的软分叉迁移路径仍有必要。

QSB的原理是反复调整候选交易数据，直到签名哈希符合比特币的验证规则，从而将安全性从椭圆曲线密码学转移到哈希函数逆向难度，据称对Shor算法具有约118比特的抗性。该交易符合共识规则，但不符合节点默认策略，需通过Slipstream直接提交给矿企MARA，成本达数百美元。
metadata.background_zh: 大多数比特币地址在首次花费之前，公钥都被隐藏在哈希之后，这为量子计算机攻击者推导私钥之前留出了一个时间窗口。QSB正是利用这一窗口，在经典公钥暴露之前构建基于哈希的花费条件。约700万枚BTC被认为已经暴露，因为其公钥已经可见，例如P2PK输出、Taproot输出以及重复使用的地址。未来拥有Shor算法的量子攻击者可以直接针对这些公钥发起攻击。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该事件主要是一项技术概念验证，没有直接的价格传导机制，但可能影响机构对比特币长期量子风险的情绪。如果QSB这类迁移方案的需求增长，MARA的Slipstream等处理非标准交易的服务使用量可能上升，但高昂成本和非标准状态目前限制了规模。

dedup_history.title: Virtu, Tradeweb complete onchain repo using Marshall Islands digital bond
dedup_history.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

metadata.title_en: Virtu, Tradeweb Complete First Onchain Repo Using Marshall Islands Digital Bond
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 27, Virtu Financial, M1X Global, and Tradeweb executed the first fully onchain repo transaction using the Republic of the Marshall Islands' USDM1 sovereign digital bond as collateral. The entire repo and repurchase cycle settled atomically on the Canton Network in under 10 minutes.

This milestone demonstrates that tokenized sovereign debt can be used as collateral in institutional financing transactions, not just for issuance or trading. It signals growing market infrastructure for onchain finance among regulated counterparties and could accelerate adoption of tokenized real-world assets.

The USDM1 bond is US dollar-denominated, backed 1:1 by short-term US Treasurys, and structured under New York law as a fully collateralized sovereign obligation. Institutional custody is provided by Anchorage Digital, BitGo, and tZERO, and the transaction was executed on the Tradeweb platform.
metadata.background_en: A repo (repurchase agreement) is a short-term financing transaction in which one party sells securities to another with a commitment to repurchase them later, commonly used for liquidity management. The Canton Network is a privacy-enabled blockchain designed for institutional finance, providing permissioned and interoperable settlement. Earlier onchain repo demonstrations relied on digital cash instruments or off-chain securities collateral, making this the first to combine natively issued sovereign collateral with fully onchain atomic settlement. The Marshall Islands uses the US dollar under its Compact of Free Association with the United States, and USDM1 complements that arrangement.
metadata.market_impact_en: This transaction showcases a real-world use case for tokenized sovereign debt as financing collateral, which could strengthen institutional confidence in onchain settlement rails and raise demand for regulated digital asset custody and RWA infrastructure. The development is most relevant to the tokenized-securities and institutional blockchain sectors rather than retail crypto markets.
metadata.title_zh: Virtu与Tradeweb完成首笔使用马绍尔群岛数字债券的链上回购
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
8月27日，Virtu Financial、M1X Global 和 Tradeweb 完成了首笔完全在链上的回购交易，使用马绍尔群岛共和国发行的 USDM1 主权数字债券作为抵押品。整个回购与再购回周期在 Canton Network 上于10分钟内原子化结算完成。

这一里程碑表明，代币化主权债券不仅可以用于发行或交易，还可以在机构融资交易中充当抵押品。它标志着受监管对手方之间的链上金融基础设施日益成熟，并可能加速代币化现实世界资产的采用。

USDM1 债券以美元计价，由短期美国国债1:1支持，并依据纽约法律构建为全额抵押的主权债务。机构托管由 Anchorage Digital、BitGo 和 tZERO 提供，交易在 Tradeweb 平台上执行。
metadata.background_zh: 回购协议（repo）是一种短期融资交易，一方出售证券并承诺稍后买回，常用于流动性管理。Canton Network 是一个为机构金融设计、支持隐私保护的区块链，提供经许可的互操作性结算。此前的链上回购演示依赖数字现金工具或链外证券抵押品，因此本次交易被视为首笔将原生发行的主权抵押品与完全链上原子结算相结合的交易。马绍尔群岛根据与美国的《自由联合协定》使用美元，USDM1 与该安排形成互补。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易展示了代币化主权债务作为融资抵押品的真实用例，可能增强机构对链上结算轨道的信心，并提升对受监管数字资产托管和 RWA 基础设施的需求。这一进展主要影响代币化证券和机构区块链领域，而非零售加密市场。

metadata.title_en: Mirae Asset details $109B crypto, stablecoin, tokenization strategy for Digital X
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
South Korean financial group Mirae Asset plans to build a 150 trillion won ($109 billion) digital asset business around Digital X, the crypto exchange formerly known as Korbit. The roadmap includes crypto trading, stablecoins, real-world assets (RWAs), and security token offerings, with plans to tokenize gold, silver, and electricity.

This marks the first time an affiliate of a South Korean financial group has acquired control of a domestic crypto exchange, signaling deeper institutional adoption in a major Asian market. The plan could reshape South Korea's crypto landscape and accelerate mainstream integration of stablecoins and tokenized RWAs.

Mirae Asset Consulting acquired a 97.15% stake in Korbit in July for a cumulative 141.4 billion won and rebranded it as Digital X. On Monday, Digital X began waiving trading fees on all won-denominated assets, with the zero-fee policy set to run through Aug. 24, 2027.
metadata.background_en: Korbit, founded in 2013, was South Korea's first cryptocurrency exchange but accounted for only about 0.5% of the country's crypto trading market in 2025. Security token offerings (STOs) involve issuing tokens that represent ownership of real or digital assets, while RWA tokenization places traditional assets like bonds, gold, or real estate on a blockchain. The plan is part of 'Mirae Asset 3.0,' a vision laid out by founder and chairman Park Hyeon-joo at a Digital X employee event in Seoul.
metadata.market_impact_en: Mirae Asset's move as a major financial group into exchange ownership, stablecoins, and tokenization could strengthen institutional confidence in the market and increase competitive pressure on other South Korean crypto venues. Digital X's zero-fee policy may affect trading volumes and liquidity distribution in the Korean won crypto market, potentially influencing sentiment around exchange-linked tokens and won trading pairs.
metadata.title_zh: 未来资产公布Digital X的1090亿美元加密、稳定币与代币化战略
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:

dedup_history.title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
dedup_history.author: TangerineDream

metadata.title_en: Cloudflare Saves 100 TB Memory by Optimizing 1.1.1.1 DNS Cache
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Cloudflare engineers detailed how they reduced memory usage by 100 terabytes across their edge network by reworking the data structures and allocation strategies in the 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver cache. The optimization cuts per-record overhead in one of the world's busiest DNS services.

This matters because it shows how careful systems-level optimization can yield massive efficiency gains in critical internet infrastructure, reducing hardware costs and energy consumption. The techniques are applicable to other high-throughput, memory-bound services and demonstrate the continued relevance of low-level programming expertise.

The optimization primarily reduces per-record memory overhead by restructuring how cache keys and entries are laid out in memory. Commenters also pointed to cache-line alignment and slab-style allocation as complementary ways to cut fragmentation and improve CPU cache behavior.
metadata.background_en: A DNS resolver cache stores recently resolved domain-name lookups so that repeated queries can be answered without contacting upstream authoritative servers. Memory footprint matters because 1.1.1.1 operates at massive scale across Cloudflare's edge network, where even a few dozen bytes saved per record can translate to terabytes globally. Common low-level techniques for this kind of optimization include slab allocation, which caches pre-created objects to reduce fragmentation, cache-line alignment to make data access more CPU-friendly, and space-efficient structures such as radix trees for string keys.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters were broadly positive, with one praising Cloudflare for optimizing only after the product was proven and profitable. Several experts offered technical critiques: a C programmer suggested storing record data directly after CacheEntry metadata, another worried that merging distinct Vecs into one with offsets weakens Rust's bounds-checking safety guarantees, and one noted that a radix tree might save even more memory than a hashmap for hostname keys.
metadata.title_zh: Cloudflare 优化 1.1.1.1 DNS 缓存，节省 100 TB 内存
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Cloudflare 工程师在一篇技术博客中详细介绍了如何通过重构 1.1.1.1 DNS 解析器缓存中的数据结构与内存分配策略，在整个边缘网络节省了 100 TB 的内存。这项优化显著降低了每个缓存记录的开销。

该优化的意义在于展示了在关键互联网基础设施中，细致的系统级优化能够带来巨大的效率提升，从而降低硬件成本与能源消耗。这些技术也适用于其他高吞吐、内存受限的服务，并且证明了底层编程专业技能依然至关重要。

该优化主要通过重新组织缓存键与记录在内存中的布局，来减少每条记录的内存开销。评论者还指出，缓存行对齐与 slab 式分配可进一步减少碎片化并提升 CPU 缓存性能。
metadata.background_zh: DNS 解析器缓存会保存最近解析过的域名查询结果，以便在收到重复查询时无需再向上游权威服务器请求。内存占用之所以重要，是因为 1.1.1.1 在 Cloudflare 全球边缘网络上以极大规模运行，每条记录省下几十字节就可能在全球范围内累积成 TB 级的内存节约。这类优化常用的底层技术包括 slab 分配器（通过缓存预创建对象来减少碎片并加速分配）、缓存行对齐（让数据访问对 CPU 更友好），以及基数树等节省空间的字符串键数据结构。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论者总体持正面态度，有人称赞 Cloudflare 在产品和业务稳定盈利之后才着手优化成本的做法。多位专家提出了技术建议与质疑：一位 C 程序员建议将记录数据直接放在缓存条目元数据之后；另一位担心把多个独立的 Vec 合并为一个并通过偏移访问会削弱 Rust 的越界检查安全保证；还有人指出，对于主机名这种键，基数树可能比哈希表更省内存。

dedup_history.title: Moonwell Loses $8.7 Million To MAMO Price Manipulation On Base
dedup_history.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Moonwell Loses $8.7M to MAMO Price Manipulation on Base
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Moonwell suffered an estimated $8.7 million loss after an attacker inflated the price of the illiquid MAMO token and borrowed against it on the Base network. The protocol responded by cutting borrow caps on all Base core markets, as well as MAMO and WELL supply caps, to 1 wei.

This attack underscores how vulnerable DeFi lending protocols remain to oracle manipulation, particularly when thinly traded tokens are used as collateral. It marks Moonwell's fourth pricing-related incident in less than a year, raising questions about the protocol's risk controls and wider confidence in lending markets.

The attacker spent roughly $7 million to pump MAMO's price, then borrowed cbBTC, USDC, WETH, and wstETH before swapping the proceeds into 8.7 million DAI held in a Tornado Cash-funded address. Security firms CertiK and PeckShield estimated the total loss at approximately $8.7 million.
metadata.background_en: Price oracle manipulation attacks exploit how smart contracts determine the value of tokens, allowing attackers to drain funds using artificially inflated prices. Moonwell is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol deployed on Base, Optimism, Moonbeam, and Moonriver, relying on oracles to price collateral assets. Illiquid tokens like MAMO are especially easy to pump, making them frequent targets for such exploits.
metadata.market_impact_en: The incident could reduce liquidity and borrowing activity on Moonwell's Base markets, since borrow caps have been slashed to nearly zero, and may weigh on sentiment around the protocol's WELL token. More broadly, it may intensify scrutiny of oracle security across lending protocols on Base, potentially affecting user confidence in similar DeFi applications.
metadata.title_zh: Moonwell 在 Base 上因 MAMO 价格操纵损失 870 万美元
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
在 Base 网络上，攻击者抬高流动性较差的 MAMO 代币价格并以此借入资产，导致 Moonwell 损失约 870 万美元。该协议随后将所有 Base 核心市场的借款上限以及 MAMO 和 WELL 的供应上限降至 1 wei。

这次攻击凸显了 DeFi 借贷协议在面对预言机操纵时的脆弱性，尤其是当使用流动性较差的代币作为抵押品时。这是 Moonwell 在不到一年内第四次发生与定价相关的事故，使人们对该协议的风险控制以及更广泛的借贷市场信心产生质疑。

攻击者花费约 700 万美元拉高 MAMO 的价格，随后借入 cbBTC、USDC、WETH 和 wstETH，并将所得资金兑换为 870 万枚 DAI，存于一个由 Tornado Cash 资助的地址中。安全公司 CertiK 和 PeckShield 估计总损失约为 870 万美元。
metadata.background_zh: 价格预言机操纵攻击利用的是智能合约评估代币价值的方式，攻击者通过人为抬高价格来从协议中抽走资金。Moonwell 是一个部署在 Base、Optimism、Moonbeam 和 Moonriver 上的去中心化借贷协议，依赖预言机对抵押资产进行定价。像 MAMO 这样流动性较差的代币尤其容易被拉高价格，因此常常成为此类攻击的目标。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这一事件可能会降低 Moonwell 在 Base 市场上的流动性和借贷活动，因为借款上限已接近归零，并可能对协议代币 WELL 的市场情绪造成压力。更广泛地看，该事件可能加剧人们对 Base 上各类借贷协议预言机安全性的审视，从而影响用户对类似 DeFi 应用的信心。

metadata.title_en: Court Ruling Deals Legal Blow to Kalshi, Affirming State Powers Over Prediction Markets

This ruling clarifies the regulatory landscape for prediction markets, which have grown popular and are closely tied to crypto-adjacent platforms. It may force Kalshi and similar services to navigate a patchwork of state rules, affecting where and how they can offer contracts.

The specific court and legal reasoning were not detailed in the available material, but the core finding is that state power to regulate prediction markets supersedes or coexists with federal oversight. Kalshi, which operates as a federally regulated exchange, now faces potential state-by-state compliance burdens.
metadata.background_en: Prediction markets are exchanges where participants trade contracts tied to the outcome of future events, with prices reflecting the crowd's collective probability estimates. Kalshi is a regulated prediction market platform in the United States, distinct from crypto-native venues like Polymarket. dedup_history.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

metadata.title_en: Solana validators approve doubling disinflation to 30% in first binding vote
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Solana validators passed SGP-0002 ('Double Disinflation'), raising the network's annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30% with 67% support and 60.7% participation. The change accelerates SOL's path to its 1.5% terminal inflation target to roughly 2.8 years, cutting projected issuance by about 18.9 million SOL over six years.

This is Solana's first binding governance vote, establishing an on-chain governance precedent while materially altering SOL's supply schedule — a key tokenomics event for a top-tier protocol. Lower future issuance reduces dilution for SOL holders, but also cuts staking rewards for validators and delegators.

Support came in at 67% with 25.16% against and 7.84% abstaining, while top voters were split: Figment voted entirely against with 17.1 million SOL staked, Helius and Jupiter overwhelmingly supported, and Kraken reversed from an initial 'no' to over 90% support. The same vote ratified a Solana Constitution and rejected a separate proposal on resource and inclusion fees.
metadata.background_en: In crypto, disinflation describes a system where the rate of new token issuance slows over time, distinct from deflation where supply actually shrinks. Solana's inflation model starts at an 8% annual rate and decreases by 15% each year — the 'disinflation rate' — until it reaches a long-term fixed 1.5% terminal inflation. SGP-0002 doubles that yearly decline, so the network hits the 1.5% floor much sooner while leaving the target itself unchanged.
metadata.market_impact_en: The proposal directly alters SOL's supply schedule, lowering projected issuance by roughly 18.9 million SOL over six years, which reduces dilution for holders but also lowers staking yield for validators and delegators. This change may influence staking participation and staking-denominated products, and the success of Solana's first binding vote adds a governance signal around tokenomics as SOL exchange-traded products continue attracting inflows.
metadata.title_zh: Solana验证者批准将通胀递减率翻倍至30%的首个约束性投票
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Solana验证者通过了SGP-0002（“双倍去通胀”）提案，以67%的支持率和60.7%的参与率将网络年度通胀递减率从15%提高至30%。这一变化将SOL达到1.5%最终通胀目标的时间缩短至约2.8年，未来六年预计减少约1890万枚SOL的发行。

这是Solana首次具有约束力的治理投票，开创了链上治理先例，同时实质性改变了SOL的供应计划，对顶级协议而言是重要的代币经济事件。未来发行量减少降低了SOL持有者的稀释，但也会降低验证者和委托者的质押奖励。

投票支持率为67%，反对25.16%，弃权7.84%；主要投票者立场分歧：质押1710万SOL的Figment全部投反对票，Helius和Jupiter压倒性支持，Kraken从最初反对转为最终超90%支持。同一场投票还批准了Solana章程，并否决了关于资源和包含费用的另一项提案。
metadata.background_zh: 在加密货币领域，“通胀递减”指新代币发行率随时间下降的机制，与供应量实际减少的“通缩”不同。Solana的通胀模型以每年8%的初始通胀率起步，每年减少15%——即“通胀递减率”——直到达到长期固定的1.5%最终通胀率。SGP-0002将年度递减幅度翻倍，使网络更早触及1.5%的底部，同时最终目标本身不变。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该提案直接改变了SOL的供应计划，未来六年预计减少约1890万枚SOL的发行，这会降低持有者的稀释，但同时也会降低验证者和委托者的质押收益。这一变化可能影响质押参与度及以质押为基础的衍生品；在SOL交易所交易产品持续吸引资金流入的背景下，Solana首次约束性投票的成功也发出了关于代币经济学的治理信号。

dedup_history.title: Kraken tips Solana’s razor-thin inflation vote
dedup_history.author: Aaron Wise

metadata.title_en: Kraken Tips Solana's Razor-Thin Inflation Vote
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Solana validators narrowly approved SGP-0002, doubling the disinflation rate from 15% to 30%. The proposal passed with 67% support, just 0.33 percentage points above the required two-thirds threshold, after Kraken's validator flipped its vote.

This is the first Solana governance proposal passed under the new binding on-chain voting system and it changes SOL's issuance schedule, reducing new SOL creation by roughly 18.9 million tokens over six years. The outcome directly affects SOL holders, stakers, and validators, and highlights the growing influence of large exchanges in network governance.

Solana remains inflationary, with terminal inflation still at 1.5% per year; the change only accelerates the timeline to reach that floor from roughly 2032 to 2029. Developers must still re-anchor the supply curve, test, and activate the feature gate. Two companion proposals, SGP-0001 (the Solana Constitution) and SGP-0003 (a fee-burn mechanism), passed and failed respectively.
metadata.background_en: Solana is a high-throughput proof-of-stake blockchain where SOL is used for fees and staking. Its inflation schedule is designed to decrease over time: a fixed starting rate declines at a disinflation rate until reaching a 1.5% long-term floor. Validators vote on-chain with stake-weighted voting; under the new Solana governance system, proposals that obtain two-thirds support become binding. Previously, a similar disinflation proposal (SIMD-0228) failed in March 2025 with about 61% support.
metadata.market_impact_en: The passage of SGP-0002 reduces expected SOL issuance over the next several years, lowering the supply-overhang channel that weighs on spot and derivative markets. It also alters staking-yield dynamics: validators and stakers earn newly minted SOL, so a faster disinflation path affects staking economics and may shift sentiment around SOL's scarcity narrative, though any effect on price is uncertain.
metadata.title_zh: Kraken 最后一刻投票助 Solana 通胀提案惊险通过
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Solana 验证者以 67% 的支持率惊险通过了 SGP-0002 提案，将通缩率（disinflation rate）从 15% 提高至 30%。该提案仅以高出所需三分之二门槛 0.33 个百分点的优势通过，此前 Kraken 的验证者最后一刻翻转了投票。

这是 Solana 在新的约束性链上投票系统下通过的首个治理提案，它改变了 SOL 的发行时间表，未来六年将减少约 1890 万枚新 SOL 的产出。这一结果直接影响 SOL 持有者、质押者和验证者，也凸显了大型交易所在网络治理中日益增长的影响力。

Solana 仍然是通胀性的，最终通胀率仍为每年 1.5%；该变化只是将到达这一底线的预期时间从约 2032 年提前到 2029 年。开发者仍需重新锚定供应曲线、测试并激活功能开关。另外两项附属提案中，SGP-0001（Solana 宪法）获得通过，SGP-0003（费用销毁机制）未获通过。
metadata.background_zh: Solana 是一个高吞吐量的权益证明（proof-of-stake）区块链，SOL 用于支付手续费和质押。其通胀率设计为随时间递减：一个固定的起始通胀率按照一定的通缩率（disinflation rate）下降，直至达到 1.5% 的长期底线。验证者通过以质押权重投票的链上机制进行治理；在新的 Solana 治理系统下，获得三分之二支持的提案即具有约束力。此前，类似的通缩提案 SIMD-0228 于 2025 年 3 月仅获得约 61% 的支持而失败。
metadata.market_impact_zh: SGP-0002 的通过降低了未来几年 SOL 的预期增发量，从而减轻了现货和衍生品市场上的供应过剩压力。同时，它改变了质押收益动态：验证者和质押者获得新铸的 SOL，因此更快的通缩路径会影响质押经济，并可能影响市场对 SOL 稀缺性的看法，但任何对价格的影响都是不确定的。

metadata.title_en: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading to Solana, Avalanche, Chainlink
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Charles Schwab announced Thursday that it plans to add Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink trading for clients in the coming months, expanding its crypto platform beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum. The additions follow the rollout of direct Bitcoin and Ether trading that began in May.

This move gives a major U.S. financial services firm's retail client base direct access to additional digital assets, potentially boosting adoption and liquidity for SOL, AVAX, and LINK. It also signals continued institutional acceptance of crypto trading despite an evolving regulatory landscape.

Eligible Schwab clients will be able to trade the new assets on the firm's website, mobile app, and thinkorswim platform, with a 0.75% fee per trade, which Schwab describes as among the industry's lowest. The company said it entered the market after U.S. regulations offered a clearer path, and it is also considering offering a dollar-pegged stablecoin.
metadata.background_en: Solana is a high-performance blockchain known for fast, low-cost transactions, used for trading, payments, and gaming apps. Avalanche enables businesses and developers to create custom blockchains for specific applications, while Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that supplies smart contracts with off-chain data such as asset prices. Schwab's move follows a 2024 announcement that it would enter crypto trading once regulatory clarity improved.
metadata.market_impact_en: By giving Schwab's large retail client base direct access to these tokens, the expansion could broaden the investor pool for SOL, AVAX, and LINK and may improve liquidity on U.S. trading venues. The move may also encourage other brokerages to follow suit, reinforcing the integration of crypto into mainstream finance, though actual flows will depend on client uptake.
metadata.title_zh: 嘉信理财将加密交易扩展至Solana、Avalanche和Chainlink
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
嘉信理财于周四宣布，计划在未来几个月内为客户新增Solana、Avalanche和Chainlink交易，将其加密平台扩展至比特币和以太坊之外。此前，该公司的直接比特币和以太坊交易已于5月开始推出。

此举使一家美国大型金融服务公司的零售客户群能够直接访问更多数字资产，可能提升SOL、AVAX和LINK的采用率和流动性。这也表明，尽管监管环境不断演变，机构对加密交易的接纳仍在持续。

符合条件的嘉信理财客户可通过该公司的网站、移动应用和thinkorswim平台交易新增资产，每笔交易收取0.75%的费用，嘉信理财称该费率处于行业最低水平。该公司表示，是在美国监管环境更加明朗后进入这一市场的，并且还在考虑推出与美元挂钩的稳定币。
metadata.background_zh: Solana是一个高性能区块链，以快速、低成本的交易著称，用于交易、支付和游戏应用。Avalanche允许企业和开发者为特定应用创建定制区块链，而Chainlink是一个去中心化预言机网络，为智能合约提供资产价格等链外数据。嘉信理财此举是在2024年宣布待监管更明确后将进入加密交易市场之后进行的。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 通过让嘉信理财庞大的零售客户群直接接触这些代币，此次扩展可能扩大SOL、AVAX和LINK的投资者基础，并可能提升美国交易场所的流动性。此举也可能鼓励其他券商效仿，强化加密货币与传统金融的融合，但实际资金流将取决于客户的参与情况。

metadata.title_en: Schwab Plans to Add SOL, AVAX, LINK Trading Across 39.9M Accounts
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Charles Schwab plans to add trading for Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK) across its 39.9 million brokerage accounts, according to a report. This marks a major expansion of direct cryptocurrency access through a mainstream U.S. brokerage.

Bringing these tokens to such a large retail investor base could significantly broaden crypto adoption and normalize holdings of altcoins within traditional brokerage portfolios. It also signals growing demand from mainstream investors for diversified digital asset exposure beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum.

The news is described as a plan rather than an immediate launch, so a specific rollout date and trading availability details were not part of the headline. Solana is a high-throughput smart-contract blockchain, Avalanche is a platform designed for DeFi and custom networks, and Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network connecting smart contracts to off-chain data.
metadata.background_en: Solana is a public blockchain platform created by Anatoly Yakovenko, using proof-of-stake consensus and known for high speed and low fees. Avalanche is a layer-1 blockchain platform with a unique consensus mechanism, aimed at DeFi and custom enterprise networks. Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that supplies real-world data to smart contracts; LINK is its native token. These three projects are among the most prominent in the crypto ecosystem outside Bitcoin and Ethereum.
metadata.market_impact_en: If implemented, the move would give 39.9 million Schwab account holders direct access to SOL, AVAX, and LINK, potentially increasing retail demand and trading volumes through a regulated U.S. brokerage. The main market transmission channels are expanded custody and trading access, improved liquidity, and a lift in sentiment for these assets; however, no specific launch date has been announced, so the actual impact depends on execution and regulatory timing.

metadata.title_en: SBI Holdings Invests $270 Million for 20% Stake in Indonesia's Ajaib
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
SBI Holdings has invested $270 million to acquire a 20% stake in Indonesian digital asset platform Ajaib. The deal expands SBI's presence in Asia's digital asset market.

The investment signals growing institutional interest in Southeast Asian digital asset infrastructure and could accelerate the development of regulated crypto and stablecoin services in the region. It also strengthens SBI's cross-border digital asset strategy in Asia.

Ajaib offers crypto and stablecoins alongside traditional investments, including OTC settlement services for institutional clients. The 20% stake implies a valuation of approximately $1.35 billion for the platform.
metadata.background_en: Stablecoins are digital tokens designed to maintain a steady price, usually pegged to the US dollar or another asset, making them useful for payments and transfers. OTC settlement services help institutional clients execute large trades outside public order books, often using mechanisms like delivery-versus-payment (DVP) and multi-signature escrow to automate and secure settlement. SBI Holdings is a major Japanese financial group expanding its digital asset operations across Asia.
metadata.market_impact_en: The $270 million investment strengthens institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure in Southeast Asia, which could improve liquidity and settlement reliability for regional crypto and stablecoin markets. Sentiment may also improve for listed companies with exposure to Asian digital asset platforms, though the direct market transmission is primarily via structural development rather than token price drivers.

dedup_history.title: KuCoin can block your crypto transactions even if you never sent it to these 17 sanctioned platforms
dedup_history.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo

metadata.title_en: KuCoin expands sanctions screening to indirect transfers touching 17 platforms
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On August 27, KuCoin announced expanded sanctions compliance screening that covers indirect transfers connected to 17 crypto platforms, including HTX (Huobi Global SA). Users can now face held or rejected transactions even if they never sent funds directly to those platforms.

This shift pushes sanctions enforcement beyond direct counterparties and into transaction provenance, with exchanges tracking whether funds touched listed services along the way. It signals a broader industry trend where major exchanges like Binance and KuCoin isolate designated platforms, constraining how HTX-linked funds can move across the ecosystem.

KuCoin has not disclosed how many transaction hops it traces or what level of on-chain attribution establishes an indirect connection. The list includes Shelbit, Aban Tether, A7 Nigeria, A7 Africa, PilotFinance, Rapira, Aifory Pro, ABCeX, WhiteBird, NoOnecrypto, Tradex, Monease, BitPapa, Exnode, Exnode Pay, EXMO, and HTX.
metadata.background_en: Crypto exchanges use blockchain analytics to screen for sanctions exposure, and this can include indirect exposure through the transaction graph — for example, funds that passed through an intermediary wallet that itself transacted with a sanctioned address. Compliance teams often rely on hop-based tracing, though some analytics tools stop at a predetermined number of hops, which can miss deeper exposures. KuCoin's notice follows similar measures by Binance, which from August 23 stopped processing transactions involving HTX and 10 other platforms. HTX disputes the sanctions-related designation, saying Huobi Global S.A. is distinct from the online HTX exchange, and is pursuing legal and compliance discussions with UK and EU authorities.
metadata.market_impact_en: The policy creates a compliance-driven friction for fund flows associated with any of the 17 listed platforms, particularly HTX, which is already facing similar restrictions on Binance. This can reduce available exchange rails for HTX-linked funds and may push affected users toward OTC desks, decentralized venues, or other exchanges, potentially affecting liquidity distribution and trading volume across major centralized platforms.
metadata.title_zh: KuCoin扩大制裁筛查，覆盖间接涉及17个平台的转账
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
8月27日，KuCoin宣布扩大制裁合规筛查范围，覆盖与包括HTX（Huobi Global SA）在内的17个加密货币平台有关联的间接转账。即使用户从未直接向这些平台发送资金，也可能面临交易被扣留或拒绝的情况。

这一转变将制裁执行从直接交易对手扩展到交易溯源层面，交易所会追踪资金在流转过程中是否接触过被列名服务。这表明币安、KuCoin等主流交易所正在隔离受指定平台，限制与HTX关联的资金在生态内的流动方式，是行业更广泛的趋势信号。

KuCoin未披露其追踪多少层交易跳数，也没说明何种链上归因水平会被认定为间接关联。名单包括Shelbit、Aban Tether、A7 Nigeria、A7 Africa、PilotFinance、Rapira、Aifory Pro、ABCeX、WhiteBird、NoOnecrypto、Tradex、Monease、BitPapa、Exnode、Exnode Pay、EXMO和HTX。
metadata.background_zh: 加密货币交易所通常使用区块链分析来筛查制裁风险，这种筛查可以涵盖通过交易图谱产生的间接敞口——例如，资金经过某个中间钱包，而该钱包本身曾与被制裁地址交易。合规团队常依赖基于“跳数”的追踪，但部分分析工具会在预设跳数（如三跳或五跳）后停止搜索，从而可能遗漏更深的关联。KuCoin的公告与币安近期的做法相似，币安自8月23日起停止处理涉及HTX及其他10个平台的交易。HTX对被制裁相关认定提出异议，称Huobi Global S.A.与在线HTX交易所并非同一实体，并正在与英国和欧盟当局进行法律及合规讨论。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该政策为涉及上述17个平台（尤其是HTX）的资金流动制造了合规性摩擦，HTX已面临币安的类似限制。这可能减少HTX关联资金可用的交易所通道，并促使受影响用户转向场外交易、去中心化平台或其他交易所，从而影响主流中心化交易所之间的流动性分布与交易量。

dedup_history.title: Red Flag? OpenAI's Agentic ChatGPT Work Signs Into Your Accounts Without You
dedup_history.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.title_en: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work Agent Signs Into Sites Without You
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
OpenAI's August 25 release notes introduced an agentic browser capability for ChatGPT Work that lets the assistant complete tasks on login-gated websites. Users enter credentials once, and the browser session can persist for future tasks so the agent can work unattended.

The feature turns a signed-in session into a standing credential, raising new security and privacy concerns about what an autonomous agent can do on a user's behalf without direct oversight. It matters to everyday ChatGPT users and to developers building on OpenAI's agentic tools, because the convenience of persistent logins comes with a meaningful tradeoff in account security.

OpenAI states the model cannot see the user's username or password, and that credentials are neither stored nor used for training; the login step also supports password managers. However, the session itself remains active until cleared manually per site under Settings > Cloud browser, and the design assumes the user is not watching.
metadata.background_en: Agentic browsing refers to a category of AI tools that autonomously navigate websites and complete multi-step tasks on the user's behalf, rather than only displaying content. A login-gated site requires authentication before granting access; in this feature, the user provides credentials once, and the agent then keeps a persistent session so it can continue acting on the account later. The key distinction is that while OpenAI protects the password itself, the authenticated session becomes a reusable access token that the agent can use until it is explicitly cleared.
metadata.title_zh: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Work 代理可在你不知情时登录网站
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
OpenAI 在8月25日的发布说明中为 ChatGPT Work 引入了代理浏览器能力，使其能在需要登录的网站上完成任务。用户只需输入一次凭据，浏览器会话即可持续，供代理在无人值守时继续工作。

该功能将会话变成了一个长期有效的凭证，引发了关于自主代理在无人监督情况下可代表用户执行何种操作的新安全与隐私担忧。这对普通 ChatGPT 用户和基于 OpenAI 代理工具构建的开发者都很重要，因为持久登录带来的便利是以账户安全为代价的。

OpenAI 表示，模型无法看到用户的用户名或密码，凭据既不会存储也不会用于训练，登录步骤还支持密码管理器。然而，会话本身会一直保持有效，直到用户在 Settings > Cloud browser 中按站点手动清除，而且该设计假设用户不会一直盯着。
metadata.background_zh: 代理浏览（agentic browsing）是指一类能自主浏览网站并代表用户完成多步骤任务的 AI 工具，而不仅仅是展示内容。需要登录的网站会要求在授予访问权限前完成身份验证；在该功能中，用户只需提供一次凭据，代理便会保持持久会话，以便稍后继续对账户进行操作。关键区别在于，OpenAI 保护的是密码本身，而经过身份验证的会话成为一种可重复使用的访问令牌，代理在使用者明确清除之前都可以使用。
